posts.title: Can AI do every PhD problem in a weekend?
posts.description: Can AI do every PhD problem in a weekend? Alessio Figalli won the 2018 Fields Medal and teaches at ETH Zurich. In September, he and 24 other Fields Medalists signed a declaration, A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics, warning that AI labs’ race to solve math problems as benchmarks could harm the field. I sat down with him in late October, two days after OpenAI announced its Yang-Mills proof.

posts.description: Aristotle Was a Genius. But He Couldn’t Count Teeth. Dear Magicians, Imagine being a scientist in the twelfth century. That’s why I wanted Kevin Knuth, a physics professor at the University at Albany, to walk me through his case that some UAP can’t be human technology.
